content.title: Are Macy's, other retailers open on Easter? Here's what to know
content.text: April 4, 2026, 6:05 a.m. ETEaster is this Sunday, an important Christian holiday that celebrates the resurrection of Jesus Christ.The day follows a 40-day period known as Lent and the date it is celebrated changes depending on the year because it is one of several "moveable feasts" in the liturgical year, according to the History Channel. This year, Easter falls on Sunday, April 5.Some restaurant and grocery store chains will be closed on Easter this year in celebration of the holiday, and that is also the case for some retail chains.Here's what you need to know about which retail stores will be open and closed on Easter in 2026.When is Easter 2026?This year, Easter falls on Sunday, April 5.Is Target open on Easter?No, Target stores will be closed on Easter Sunday this year, the company confirmed to USA TODAY.Is Walmart open on Easter?Yes, Walmart stores will be open regular hours on Easter, according to the company's website. Most Walmart stores are open from 6 a.m. to 11 p.m. daily.Is Home Depot open on Easter?Yes, Home Depot stores will be open 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Easter, the company confirmed to USA TODAY.Is Lowe's open on Easter?No, all Lowe's stores will be closed on April 5, the company announced in a March 25 news release.Is Ace Hardware open on Easter?While most Ace Hardware stores are expected to remain open on Easter, stores are independently owned and operated, with locations' hours varying.Customers are encouraged to contact their local store to confirm business hours on Easter.Are TJ Maxx, Marshall's or HomeGoods open on Easter?No, all three stores will be closed on Easter Sunday, the company told USA TODAY.Is Victoria's Secret open on Easter?Most U.S. stores will be closed on Easter, some will be open and are subject to their mall's hours of operation, the company told USA TODAY.Is Sephora open on Easter?Sephora store hours vary by location, and customers are encouraged to use the company's store locator for specific store hours.Is Barnes & Noble open on Easter?Hours vary by location; most Barnes & Noble stores will be open regular hours on Easter, the company told USA TODAY. Customers are encouraged to confirm holiday hours with their local store.Is Macy's open on Easter?No, Macy's stores will be closed on April 5, the company told USA TODAY.Is Nordstrom open on Easter?Most Nordstrom and Nordstrom Rack stores will be closed on April 5, the company told USA TODAY.The following stores, however, will be open on the holiday:The Tower & Men's Store; New York, New York; 12 p.m. to 6 p.m.Nordstrom Rack at 31st & 6th, Nordstrom Rack at Union Square: New York, New York; 12 p.m. to 5 p.m.Town Center at Boca Raton; Boca Raton, Florida; 11 a.m. to 7 p.m.Southcenter; Tukwila, Washington; 11 a.m. to 6 p.m.Valley Fair; San Jose, California; 11 a.m. to 6 p.m.The Grove; Los Angeles, California; 11 a.m. to 8 p.m.Century City; Century City, California; 11 a.m. to 7 p.m.Is Kohl's open on Easter?No, Kohl's stores will be closed on Sunday, April 5, the company told USA TODAY.Is Belk open on Easter?All Belk, Belk Outlet, and Belk Market stores will be closed on Easter Sunday, the company told USA TODAY.Are Bass Pro Shops or Cabela's open on Easter?Yes, both stores will be open from 10 a.m. to 7 p.m. local time on Easter.Some locations are subject to the hours of their malls or shopping centers, so the company recommends checking with your local store for specific holiday hours.Is REI open on Easter?Yes, REI stores will be open from noon to 6 p.m. on Easter Sunday, the company told USA TODAY.Is IKEA open on Easter?Yes, IKEA stores open at their regular times and close at 6 p.m. local time on Easter, the company confirmed to USA TODAY.Is Petco open on Easter?Yes, Petco stores will be open regular hours on April 5, the company confirmed to USA TODAY.Is PetSmart open on Easter?Yes, PetSmart stores will be open from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Easter Sunday.Are Office Depot and OfficeMax open on Easter?All Office Depot and OfficeMax stores will be closed on Easter, the company told USA TODAY.Is Tractor Supply Company open on Easter?Yes, Tractor Supply Co. stores will be open from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Easter, the company told USA TODAY.Gabe Hauari is a national trending news reporter at USA TODAY.
